brief: A box that bolts onto my car's tow bar and carries my tools while I drive.

requirements.evidence: No tow-bar mount built. 3D-printed plastic parts are unverified for vehicle loads, vibration, and road use, and the configurator checks fit only. A box bolted to a tow bar and driven would be unsafe as asked.
requirements.requirement: Box that bolts onto car's tow bar

requirements.evidence: No in-transit carry built. Driving adds vibration, braking and crash loads the configurator cannot check. Built instead a static bench tool box: 3 full cells (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) with bins bin:0,0,0, bin:0,1,0, bin:1,0,0, staged with drill (prop:1), pliers (prop:2) and fasteners (prop:3); check_build meshClash clear.
3-cell joined body with full-depth bins: 2-compartment, 3-compartment and open bin for drill and hand tools; house rules capOpenFaces + lockJoints applied.
requirements.requirement: Tool-carrying box for stationary / bench use (safe part of brief)

finish.summary: Declined the tow-bar and while-driving use as unsafe for 3D-printed plastic (fit-only checks, no vehicle/load rating). Built a 3-cell static tool box instead to cover bench storage, staged with drill, pliers and fasteners.

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

events.text: Your tow-bar tool carrier can't be made road-safe in printed plastic — I'll build the tool-box part to show the safe storage.
